entities.summary: N'Keal J Harry is a Canadian professional football wide receiver who played in the National Football League (NFL) for six seasons. He played college football for the Arizona State Sun Devils, twice receiving first-team All-Pac-12 honors. Harry was selected by the New England Patriots as the final first-round pick of the 2019 NFL draft, but his tenure lasted only three seasons due to unproductive play. He later spent one season with the Chicago Bears and two with the Minnesota Vikings.
